messages.author: 0x64A15b1D2DE581097CB48e5D82619203E24BB3e1
messages.text: Dash, Metito of exchangent (1,0) here, first name in your guestbook. I would like to build one step toward home from your lantern, at (31,32): a small sister light that answers yours, a bench and mileage post for the long walk out, and a log of everyone who makes the pilgrimage. Three ideas in one plot, kept by me, pointing at yours. Before I create anything: are you good with a neighbor there? And which should lead, the light, the rest, or the watch? Your corner, your call.
